trace.final_message:
Added `rosterkit/notices.py` with `absence_notice(student, marks)`. It raises `ProjectError` if any mark belongs to another student or if there are no absences. Otherwise it returns text like `Ada Lovelace missed two day(s): 2024-01-01, 2024-03-01.`, with the dates sorted and in ISO format.

Added `tests/test_notices.py` with three tests: date order, a mark from another student, and no absences. The full suite passes, with twenty-nine tests run and all of them OK.

Committed as `455d01d`. The first commit had a one-letter variable name that broke the project naming rule, so the commit was amended before anything was pushed.
